settings.custom_liquid:
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bricolage+Grotesque:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=Montserrat:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap');

  #po-about-luxe,
  #po-about-luxe * {
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }

  #po-about-luxe {
    --po-page-width: 1280px;

    /* Actual Brand Colors */
    --po-pink: #fcb6eb;
    --po-dark-green: #293f07;
    --po-green: #95ad4f;
    --po-orange: #ff960e;
    --po-purple: #927ec3;
    --po-white: #ffffff;

    /* Brand Fonts */
    --po-font-header-1: "Degular Demo Black", "Bricolage Grotesque", "Montserrat", sans-serif;
    --po-font-header-2: "Bricolage Grotesque", "Montserrat", sans-serif;
    --po-font-body: "Montserrat Classic", "Montserrat", Arial, sans-serif;

    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 8% 4%, rgba(149, 173, 79, 0.18), transparent 30%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 92% 20%, rgba(255, 150, 14, 0.1), transparent 28%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 50% 100%, rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.045), transparent 34%),
      var(--po-white);
    color: var(--po-dark-green);
    font-family: var(--po-font-body);
  }

  #po-about-luxe::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 24px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.1);
    border-radius: 36px;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  #po-about-luxe::after {
    content: "about us";
    position: absolute;
    right: -18px;
    top: 46px;
    color: rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.04);
    font-family: var(--po-font-header-1);
    font-size: clamp(76px, 11vw, 170px);
    font-weight: 900;
    line-height: 0.8;
    letter-spacing: -0.07em;
    white-space: nowrap;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__container {
    max-width: var(--po-page-width);
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 24px;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__intro {
    max-width: 920px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 92px 0 42px;
    text-align: center;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__eyebrow {
    width: fit-content;
    margin: 0 auto 18px;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    background: rgba(149, 173, 79, 0.18);
    color: var(--po-dark-green);
    border: 1px solid rgba(149, 173, 79, 0.36);
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 10px 18px;
    font-family: var(--po-font-header-2);
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: 0.16em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__eyebrow::before {
    content: "";
    width: 10px;
    height: 10px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--po-orange);
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__title {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--po-dark-green);
    font-family: var(--po-font-header-1);
    font-size: clamp(42px, 5.8vw, 82px);
    line-height: 0.94;
    letter-spacing: -0.065em;
    font-weight: 900;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__title .accent {
    color: var(--po-orange);
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: 900;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__lead {
    margin: 24px auto 0;
    max-width: 780px;
    color: rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.74);
    font-family: var(--po-font-body);
    font-size: 16.5px;
    line-height: 1.72;
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__lead + .po-about-luxe__lead {
    margin-top: 16px;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__intro-pills {
    margin-top: 30px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__intro-pills span {
    min-height: 38px;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 0 14px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--po-white);
    border: 1px solid rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.12);
    color: rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.76);
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1;
    font-weight: 800;
    box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.06);
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__intro-pills span::before {
    content: "✓";
    color: var(--po-orange);
    font-weight: 950;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(300px, 0.9fr) minmax(380px, 1.1fr);
    gap: 64px;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 50px 0;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__grid--reverse {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(380px, 1.1fr) minmax(300px, 0.9fr);
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__content {
    max-width: 580px;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__section-kicker {
    width: fit-content;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    color: var(--po-orange);
    font-family: var(--po-font-header-2);
    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__section-kicker::before {
    content: "";
    width: 28px;
    height: 4px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--po-green);
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__section-title {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--po-dark-green);
    font-family: var(--po-font-header-1);
    font-size: clamp(32px, 3.6vw, 54px);
    line-height: 0.98;
    letter-spacing: -0.058em;
    font-weight: 900;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__section-title em {
    color: var(--po-orange);
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: 900;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__section-text {
    margin: 18px 0 0;
    color: rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.74);
    font-family: var(--po-font-body);
    font-size: 15.6px;
    line-height: 1.72;
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__list {
    list-style: none;
    margin: 24px 0 0;
    padding: 0;
    display: grid;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__list li {
    position: relative;
    padding-left: 28px;
    color: rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.74);
    font-size: 15px;
    line-height: 1.55;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__list li::before {
    content: "✓";
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 1px;
    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(255, 150, 14, 0.13);
    color: var(--po-orange);
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 950;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__center {
    max-width: 940px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 60px 0;
    text-align: center;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__center .po-about-luxe__section-kicker {
    margin-left: auto;
    margin-right: auto;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__center .po-about-luxe__section-text {
    max-width: 780px;
    margin-left: auto;
    margin-right: auto;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__center-list {
    width: fit-content;
    max-width: 100%;
    margin: 24px auto 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
    text-align: left;
    display: grid;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__center-list li {
    position: relative;
    padding-left: 24px;
    color: rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.74);
    font-size: 15px;
    line-height: 1.55;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__center-list li::before {
    content: "✓";
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    color: var(--po-orange);
    font-weight: 900;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__image-wrap {
    position: relative;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__image-card {
    position: relative;
    border-radius: 34px;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: rgba(149, 173, 79, 0.12);
    border: 1px solid rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.12);
    box-shadow: 0 26px 64px rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.14);
    isolation: isolate;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__image-card img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 460px;
    display: block;
    object-fit: cover;
    object-position: center;
    transition: transform 0.45s ease, filter 0.45s ease;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__image-card:hover img {
    transform: scale(1.05);
    filter: saturate(1.08) contrast(1.04);
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__image-card::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background:
      linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.02), rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.18)),
      radial-gradient(circle at 20% 20%, rgba(255, 150, 14, 0.13), transparent 32%);
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 2;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__image-card--founder {
    max-width: 520px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    border-radius: 36px;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__image-card--founder img {
    height: 560px;
    object-fit: cover;
    object-position: center top;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__image-card--sustainability img {
    height: 540px;
    object-position: center;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__sticker {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 4;
    left: -18px;
    bottom: 28px;
    width: min(265px, 72%);
    padding: 20px 20px 18px;
    border-radius: 24px;
    background: var(--po-orange);
    color: var(--po-dark-green);
    box-shadow: 0 22px 48px rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.18);
    transform: rotate(-3deg);
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__sticker strong {
    display: block;
    font-family: var(--po-font-header-1);
    font-size: 25px;
    line-height: 1.02;
    letter-spacing: -0.045em;
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: 900;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__sticker span {
    display: block;
    margin-top: 8px;
    font-family: var(--po-font-header-2);
    font-size: 10px;
    line-height: 1.3;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    opacity: 0.78;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__badge {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 4;
    right: -16px;
    top: 26px;
    width: 114px;
    height: 114px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--po-dark-green);
    color: var(--po-white);
    box-shadow: 0 20px 46px rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.22);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    text-align: center;
    transform: rotate(6deg);
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__badge strong {
    display: block;
    color: var(--po-orange);
    font-family: var(--po-font-header-1);
    font-size: 30px;
    line-height: 0.9;
    letter-spacing: -0.04em;
    font-weight: 900;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__badge span {
    display: block;
    margin-top: 7px;
    font-size: 8px;
    line-height: 1.2;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: 0.13em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__content-card {
    padding: 34px;
    border-radius: 30px;
    background: var(--po-white);
    border: 1px solid rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.12);
    box-shadow:
      inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 1),
      0 18px 46px rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.07);
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__highlight {
    margin-top: 24px;
    padding: 20px 22px;
    border-left: 4px solid var(--po-orange);
    border-radius: 18px;
    background: rgba(255, 150, 14, 0.09);
    color: rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.78);
    font-size: 14.8px;
    line-height: 1.65;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__values {
    margin-top: 32px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 14px;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__value {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    padding: 22px 18px;
    border-radius: 24px;
    background: var(--po-white);
    border: 1px solid rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.12);
    box-shadow: 0 16px 38px rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.06);
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__value::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    width: 72px;
    height: 72px;
    right: -28px;
    top: -28px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(149, 173, 79, 0.18);
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__value:nth-child(2n)::before {
    background: rgba(255, 150, 14, 0.14);
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__value-num {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    color: var(--po-dark-green);
    font-family: var(--po-font-header-1);
    font-size: 34px;
    line-height: 1;
    letter-spacing: -0.045em;
    font-weight: 900;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__value-label {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    margin-top: 8px;
    color: rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.66);
    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.35;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: 0.09em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__fresh-panel {
    margin: 34px auto 0;
    padding: 0;
    border-radius: 36px;
    background: var(--po-white);
    color: var(--po-dark-green);
    text-align: left;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(300px, 0.9fr) minmax(420px, 1.1fr);
    gap: 0;
    align-items: stretch;
    box-shadow:
      inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 1),
      0 24px 62px rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.12);
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__fresh-title-card {
    position: relative;
    padding: 42px 38px;
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 18% 16%, rgba(255, 150, 14, 0.14), transparent 34%),
      linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(149, 173, 79, 0.16), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.76));
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__fresh-panel h3 {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--po-dark-green);
    font-family: var(--po-font-header-1);
    font-size: clamp(38px, 4.6vw, 68px);
    line-height: 0.94;
    letter-spacing: -0.06em;
    font-weight: 900;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__fresh-panel h3 em {
    color: var(--po-orange);
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: 900;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__fresh-body {
    padding: 42px 38px;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__fresh-panel p {
    margin: 0;
    color: rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.74);
    font-size: 15.8px;
    line-height: 1.7;
    font-weight: 550;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__fresh-pills {
    margin-top: 22px;
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 9px;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__fresh-pills span {
    min-height: 38px;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 7px;
    padding: 0 14px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(149, 173, 79, 0.12);
    border: 1px solid rgba(149, 173, 79, 0.22);
    color: rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.78);
    font-size: 12.5px;
    line-height: 1;
    font-weight: 850;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__fresh-pills span::before {
    content: "✓";
    color: var(--po-orange);
    font-weight: 950;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__cta-wrap {
    padding: 86px 0 96px;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__cta {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 74px 34px;
    border-radius: 42px;
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 18% 16%, rgba(255, 150, 14, 0.18), transparent 34%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 88% 76%, rgba(149, 173, 79, 0.2), transparent 34%),
      linear-gradient(145deg, var(--po-dark-green) 0%, #203405 58%, #172603 100%);
    color: var(--po-white);
    box-shadow: 0 34px 86px rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.24);
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__cta::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 18px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.13);
    border-radius: 30px;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__cta::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    left: 50%;
    bottom: -160px;
    width: 560px;
    height: 260px;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(255, 150, 14, 0.12);
    filter: blur(20px);
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__cta-title {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    max-width: 880px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    font-family: var(--po-font-header-1);
    font-size: clamp(38px, 5vw, 68px);
    line-height: 0.96;
    letter-spacing: -0.06em;
    font-weight: 900;
    color: var(--po-white);
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__cta-title em {
    color: var(--po-orange);
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: 900;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__cta-text {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    margin: 22px auto 0;
    max-width: 640px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78);
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 1.65;
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__btn {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-height: 54px;
    padding: 0 30px;
    margin-top: 30px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--po-orange);
    color: var(--po-dark-green);
    text-decoration: none;
    font-family: var(--po-font-header-2);
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: 0.13em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    box-shadow:
      0 18px 42px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22),
      0 0 0 7px rgba(255, 150, 14, 0.08);
    transition:
      transform 0.25s ease,
      box-shadow 0.25s ease,
      background 0.25s ease;
  }

  #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__btn:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    background: var(--po-green);
    box-shadow:
      0 24px 54px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28),
      0 0 0 9px rgba(149, 173, 79, 0.1);
  }

  @media (max-width: 980px) {
    #po-about-luxe::before,
    #po-about-luxe::after {
      display: none;
    }

    #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__grid,
    #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__grid--reverse {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 34px;
      padding: 40px 0;
    }

    #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__grid--reverse .po-about-luxe__image-wrap {
      order: -1;
    }

    #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__content {
      max-width: 100%;
    }

    #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__image-card--founder {
      max-width: 620px;
    }

    #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__image-card--founder img {
      height: 520px;
    }

    #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__values {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    }

    #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__fresh-panel {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__fresh-title-card,
    #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__fresh-body {
      padding: 34px 28px;
    }
  }

  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__container {
      padding: 0 16px;
    }

    #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__intro {
      padding: 62px 0 24px;
    }

    #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__eyebrow {
      font-size: 10.5px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }

    #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__title {
      font-size: clamp(36px, 11vw, 48px);
      line-height: 1;
    }

    #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__lead,
    #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__section-text {
      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1.62;
    }

    #po-about-luxe .po-about-luxe__image-card {
      border-radius: 24px;
